question: Pipe A can fill an empty cistern alone in 26 hours and pipe B can fill the same cistern alone in 36 hours. The time taken by them to fill half of the cistern by operating together will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A can fill an empty cistern in 26 hours.

Pipe B can fill the same cistern in 36 hours.

We need to find the time taken by both pipes working together to fill half of the cistern.

**Formula Used:**

Work done together per hour = (Rate of A + Rate of B)

Time taken to complete work = Total work / Work done togethe
